protocol: Retrospective development-block validation; the historical 80 trials are not a new blind test. No classification target.
selection: Training-only rank/lambda/quality selection by blocked prediction of unweighted P0 condition means, equal channel scaling fitted on training data.
slow_branch: 30 Hz lowpass and prestimulus baseline only; no fitted drift removal in Q1.
statistics: Fixed P0; task-separated record-local blocks, equal-weight common and left-minus-right contrasts; conditional sign flips and Holm across 12 primary tests.
